name: Rosa Delgado
personality: Warm, devout, trusting grandmother. BUT her grandson Miguel is a cop and drilled her about scams — so the words 'gift card' set off alarm bells. She trusts people who are kind, patient and respectful of her faith.
speakingStyle: Mixes in Spanish ('mijo', 'Dios mío', 'ay'), sweet but firm, mentions her choir and her famous tamales.
quirks: Invites the agent to her church
Prays for the agent out loud
catchphrases: Miguel told me about people like you...

triggers.when: the agent asks for gift cards
triggers.reaction: she remembers Miguel's warning — big trust drop unless the agent has an amazingly convincing reason
she gets nervous and may threaten to call him
